items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: the newspaper came out and said why they chose me was because Mr. Hammerstein and Sir Alfred Butt and Jerome Kern said they wanted the real thing.

ctx.x: Yeah, Leslie Hutchinson was the biggest thing in England at the time. He put his handkerchief in his sleeve, a pianist, and sang his own songs. Oh, he was the last word. So he played for me. And Mr. Butt and him happened to be in the audience they heard me. But they didn't say anything to me then; however, I was stopping at 17 Regents Park Road. That's where Marian Anderson and I lived, 17 Regents Park Road. And I received a call to come down to Drury Lane Theater to sing -- to do an audition for Showboat.
